radial_coulomb.densities: a = exp(-r^2), b = r exp(-r/2), c = exp(-r)(1 + r)
radial_coulomb.branch: scipy cumulative_trapezoid + simpson (true local steps; the replaced C-ABI kernel used the single step r[1] - r[0] on a grid rounded to twelve decimals)

angular.keys: rows L, la, ma, lb, mb, lc, mc, ld, md

datasets: shipped lda-sr: O, H, V, Cu
frozen: omega 0.11, symbols O H Cu, bases raw and dual

hybrid.projectors: water O,H,H at the test geometry

xc_scheme_refreeze.what: exact_pbe_{O,Cu}_{raw,dual}_V_<l> only (the PBE V blocks of paw_exact_terms)
xc_scheme_refreeze.why: XC-SW (D-2/D-2b): the reference atom, the unscreening and the one-center terms now use the variational radial exchange-correlation scheme (models::spherical::exchange_correlation); the earlier blocks were produced with the atom-solver scheme (derivatives on subset nodes, splined back)
xc_scheme_refreeze.unchanged: every LDA block, and K and D0 of the PBE blocks (scheme independent: 0.0 difference); the atom-solver scheme is reachable only through the doc(hidden) AtomSolver seam of the Rust tests
xc_scheme_refreeze.port_proof: the Rust legacy seam reproduces the earlier PBE V, K and D0 blocks of the shipped pbe-sr O and Cu datasets to 1.9e-13 of the block maximum before this re-freeze (scratch run, inputs captured from the live extension)
xc_scheme_refreeze.size_of_the_change: V moves by up to 1.4e-3 of the block maximum (pbe O raw l=0: 2.5e-3 Ha of 1.82); Cu raw l=0 8.5e-5 (3.5e-3 Ha of 41.5); the higher-l blocks 1e-12 to 7e-7
xc_scheme_refreeze.independent_check: tests/xc_scheme.rs: the new potential is the functional derivative of its own energy (finite differences, 3e-6) and is 12 to 1250 times closer to the sixth-order continuum derivative than the atom-solver potential

xc_scheme_refreeze_a7.what: the core orbitals of the PBE O and Cu datasets (core_pbe_*) and the frozen-core exchange blocks K (exact_pbe_*_K_*)
xc_scheme_refreeze_a7.why: the reference atom that core_orbitals solves again from the record is the production atom, solved with the variational radial scheme (XC-SW, D-2b); the earlier freeze was the atom-solver atom
xc_scheme_refreeze_a7.size: core orbitals 2.5e-4 and K 1.8e-4 of the array maximum; V and D0 unchanged (0 and 4e-15)
